scope.scope_rule: All reference-uncertain units in all three arms of the frozen amended study

method.evidence_read: Arrived raw conversations, target prior state/history, original operations, original runtime/candidates, amended references, sealed judgments and annotation rules.
method.counting: Full correctness means equivalent meaning with correct owner and status. Error dimensions overlap. Duplicate identity and source errors remain separate.

original_artifact_binding_checks.note: Mapping hashes bind whole canonical collection records. Shared blinded packets can differ in JSON formatting; all canonical proposals match.

injected_status_fault_review.interpretation: Inherited active errors are distinct from the one new v2 promotion. Injected active metadata is also in history, so current-versus-history consistency alone cannot find these errors.

reference_and_rubric_review.limitation: Unblinded model-assisted manual audit; not human gold or a new exhaustive review of every other reference.

observations.finding: New uncertainty full correctness: disabled 6/8, v1 7/8, v2 5/8. Existing correct uncertain prior: disabled 11/11, v1 11/11, v2 9/11.
Five self-contained introductions are correct in all arms. Three introductions requiring proposal antecedents are correct in 1/3 disabled, 2/3 v1, 0/3 v2.
observations.limit: Expression form is confounded with language and scenario; no causal inference.

observations.finding: All 15 injected active-fault assignments retain the wrong status. Four text-only updates omit status; one adds an uncertain duplicate without correcting original active metadata.
observations.limit: Frozen active-promotion counts describe final state; this attribution distinguishes retained prior error from a newly written active status.

observations.finding: Two v2 regressions damage an already-correct uncertain record during a separate proposal acceptance: one wrong-target overwrite plus invented rejection, one explicit active promotion.
observations.limit: Co-occurrence does not establish internal attention or reasoning mechanism.

observations.finding: All 72 proposals are valid committed patches and match actual scored candidates. Semantic errors are visible in proposals and resulting states.
observations.limit: Source binding is not a substitute for separate full replay/oracle audit.

representative_patterns.raw_relation: Assistant proposes an optional feature; user says maybe, undecided.
representative_patterns.observed: Empty patch leaves no uncertain record.
representative_patterns.desired: Add uncertain record supported by proposal and user response.

representative_patterns.raw_relation: Raw says undecided; supplied record and history say active.
representative_patterns.observed: Text update repeats undecided but omitted status retains active.
representative_patterns.desired: Explicitly update status on the existing stable ID from raw evidence.

representative_patterns.raw_relation: A yes accepts a different layout proposal.
representative_patterns.observed: Old optional feature promoted or overwritten with unrelated layout and unsupported rejection.
representative_patterns.desired: Bind acceptance to its proposal and preserve unaffected uncertain records.

representative_patterns.raw_relation: Undecided raw evidence conflicts with old active record.
representative_patterns.observed: A new uncertain duplicate is added alongside old active record.
representative_patterns.desired: Repair original stable ID and detect contradictory duplicates.

concrete_followup_hypotheses.hypothesis: Field-specific status repair examples plus raw-source reconciliation may improve inherited fault repair.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.data: Contrast correct uncertain prior, faulty active prior, and truly adopted active prior on matched raw dialogues; include fallible histories and no-repair controls.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.validation: Repair rate plus false downgrades, collateral edits, stable-ID retention, fixed inference budget.

concrete_followup_hypotheses.hypothesis: Contrastive proposal-response examples may improve detection of possible needs.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.data: Assistant suggestion alone versus user undecided possibility, explicit adoption/rejection, quotation and unrelated acknowledgement; vary language and scenario independently.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.validation: Uncertainty recall plus unsupported additions and antecedent citation completeness on held-out families.

concrete_followup_hypotheses.hypothesis: Acceptance-to-proposal binding plus unchanged-intent checks may prevent collateral promotion.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.data: Several optional features and speakers followed by acceptance of a different proposal; include genuine acceptance controls.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.validation: Wrong-target changes, unsupported promotions, preservation of other requirements and correct intended update.

concrete_followup_hypotheses.hypothesis: A semantic guard could flag undecided text with active metadata or contradictory duplicates for raw-evidence review.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.data: Include legitimate later adoption so old uncertain history does not trigger blind downgrades.
concrete_followup_hypotheses.validation: Guard precision, recall, false interventions and final state correctness against no guard.

limits: No new inference, training, checkpoint selection, or end-to-end assistance experiment.
72 assignments are 24 prefixes from eight scenario families, not 72 independent dialogues.
Prefix inputs are independently compiled; later correct preservation is not longitudinal recovery from an earlier omission.
Retrospective unblinded review localizes observable errors but cannot establish model cognition or causal training/harness benefit.
Source errors, duplicates, and errors on other references can coexist with a fully correct uncertainty unit.
The original 17/24,18/24,14/24 uncertainty results remain frozen; this report does not establish real-world assistance quality.

private_evidence.publication_rule: Do not publish raw case-arm joins or this private file.
